title: You'll Be the Death of Me
author: Karen M. McManus
description: A gripping young-adult mystery about three friends who skip school for a day of adventure, only to witness a murder and become entangled in a dangerous investigation filled with secrets, suspicion, and unexpected twists.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A gripping psychological thriller about Alicia Berenson, a famous painter who suddenly stops speaking after being accused of murdering her husband. Psychotherapist Theo Faber becomes determined to uncover the truth behind her silence, leading to a dark mystery filled with secrets, obsession, and unexpected twists.

title: The Woman in the Window
author: A. J. Finn
description: A psychological thriller about Anna Fox, a woman who rarely leaves her home and spends her days watching her neighbors. When she witnesses something shocking through her window, she begins to question what she really saw as reality, fear, and deception become increasingly blurred.

title: GONE GIRL
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A psychological thriller about Nick Dunne, whose wife Amy mysteriously disappears on their anniversary. As the investigation unfolds, secrets and lies emerge, forcing Nick—and the reader—to question what really happened and who can be trusted.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
author: Rock_Paper_Scissors
description: A psychological thriller about a troubled married couple who travel to a remote Scottish church for an anniversary getaway. As hidden secrets and old resentments surface, they begin to realize that neither of them is being completely honest, leading to a tense and twist-filled mystery.

title: Verity
author: Lowen Ashleigh
description: A psychological thriller about Lowen Ashleigh, a struggling writer hired to complete a bestselling author’s unfinished books. While staying with the author’s family, Lowen discovers a disturbing manuscript that reveals dark secrets and forces her to question what is real.

title: Blood Orange
author: Halle, Karina
description: A gripping psychological thriller about a lawyer whose personal life begins to unravel while she defends a woman accused of murder. As secrets emerge and danger closes in, she must confront the dark truths surrounding both the case and her own life.

title: Greek Row
author: Phynley Meyers
description: A dark contemporary mystery about college students caught in a web of secrets, rivalries, and dangerous relationships within a Greek-life community. As tensions rise, hidden truths begin to surface, putting friendships and lives at risk.

title: Hidden Pictures
author: Jason Rekulak
description: A psychological thriller about a struggling young woman who becomes a caregiver for a wealthy family and discovers disturbing hidden drawings made by their autistic son. As she investigates the mysterious pictures, she uncovers secrets that put her own life in danger.

title: That's Not My Name
author: Megan Lally
description: A supernatural thriller about Mallory Quinn, a young woman who takes a babysitting job and discovers that five-year-old Teddy’s increasingly disturbing drawings may reveal the details of a long-unsolved murder. As Mallory investigates, she uncovers terrifying secrets surrounding the family and their home.

title: Cross My Heart
author: Megan Collins
description: A tense crime thriller in which detective Alex Cross faces his most dangerous enemy yet—a criminal who targets his family. As those closest to him are placed in grave danger, Cross must fight to protect them while confronting a deeply personal threat.
